market_summary: During the London session, major pairs and assets are displaying mixed consolidation and low-volume mean-reversions. EURUSD and GBPUSD are testing resistance at their Session Highs and Value Area Highs without the requisite RVOL > 2.0 volume confirmation, while XAUUSD and BTCUSD remain structurally bearish beneath declining VWAP and EMA50 baselines with counter-trend bounces underway. All four setups lack decisive volume-backed breakout or rejection triggers, warranting a disciplined HOLD across the board.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3969.92) and below POC (3978.28), trading well below VWAP (3972.12) and EMA50 (3970.44). CVD is BEARISH (-3.14) with a slight upward slope (+1.44) reflecting the current minor mean-reversion bounce off Session Low (3924.30). ATR channel is expanding. RVOL is low at 0.601 with no yellow spikes confirming the counter-trend bounce. In LONDON_SESSION, the forming candle is pushing toward EMA20 baseline (3953.43) within a strong macro downtrend, presenting an unfavorable risk-reward to chase either direction mid-range. HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping vwap and ema50

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area testing VAH (1.10981) and trading at POC (1.10946). Close is above VWAP (1.10850) and EMA50 (1.10883). CVD is BULLISH (+5311.71) with accelerating positive slope (+4660.67), fully agreeing with upward momentum. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is hugging the upper ATR band (1.10977) and pressing against Session High (1.10988) and S/R (1.11007). However, RVOL is only 0.824 without a yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout spike into key resistance, making an immediate breakout suspect. HOLD for clean breakout acceptance or pullback to VWAP.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish holding above rising vwap and ema50
signals.level_event: acceptance above vwap and testing vah

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area, above VWAP (1.32663) and EMA50 (1.32696), with close slightly below POC (1.32738) on the closed bar but live price expanding to 1.32769. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1338.79) with positive slope (+1406.59), presenting slight divergence against price advance. Session is LONDON_SESSION. The forming candle is approaching Session High resistance at 1.32809 and the upper ATR band (1.32800). RVOL is muted at 0.761 lacking yellow volume expansion. Risk of rejection at Session High/VAH (1.32797) dictates a HOLD.
signals.level_event: acceptance above vwap approaching session high

signals.rationale: Signal candle closed below VAL (73397.14) and below POC (73541.61), under falling VWAP (73612.03) and EMA50 (73618.59). CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) with neutral slope. In LONDON_SESSION, the forming bar bounced from S/R 73284.60 back inside the lower edge of the Value Area near EMA20 baseline (73446.84) to 73497.70 without yellow RVOL confirmation (RVOL 1.171). Price is caught in chop between Session Low (73166.00) and POC (73541.61) / VWAP overhead resistance. HOLD until a confirmed breakdown or clean VWAP reclaim.
